review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies warehouse replication compatibility and recovery guidance for PostHog warehouse ingestion, potentially reducing configuration errors.
review.reason: Replaces a disabled replication reason string with a more actionable message suggesting full table replication, providing clearer guidance to warehouse users.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the assumption that this clearer message will reduce support queries or configuration errors, which is not independently verified by the code or release notes.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Replaced the disabled reason string for incremental and append-only replication with a longer message suggesting full table replication.
observations.code_quote: "Append only replication isn't supported on this table. Use full table replication instead.",
observations.posthog_connection: Provides clearer guidance to warehouse users when incremental or append-only replication is unavailable, potentially reducing support queries or configuration errors.
